description:
Redis through Jedis or Lettuce with the password off the heap. Jedis: a
    socket factory that opens the connection itself - on seclume's own TLS 1.3
    when it is encrypted - and authenticates with AUTH written from native
    memory, before Jedis gets the socket. Lettuce: a placeholder in place of
    the password, replaced from native memory on its way out - inside
    seclume's TLS 1.3 under Netty. Neither client ever holds the password.
